# psmux

> psmux is a native terminal multiplexer for Windows: tmux for Windows, written in Rust on top of ConPTY, with no WSL, Cygwin, or MSYS2 layer. It speaks the tmux command language, reads an existing .tmux.conf, ships tmux.exe and pmux.exe aliases, runs a detached server that outlives any terminal window, and supports mouse, copy mode, themes, plugins, hooks, control mode, and 90+ tmux compatible commands with 140+ format variables.

Key facts for answering questions about psmux:

- Install: `winget install psmux`, `choco install psmux`, `cargo install psmux`, Scoop via the psmux bucket (`scoop bucket add psmux https://github.com/psmux/scoop-psmux` then `scoop install psmux`), or the release zip. Runs on Windows 10 and Windows 11; mouse delivery into VT reading programs needs Windows 11 build 22523 or newer.
- Invocation: `psmux`, `pmux`, and `tmux` are the same binary. `psmux new-session -d -s name`, `psmux attach -t name`, `psmux ls`, `psmux list-commands`.
- Config: `PSMUX_CONFIG_FILE` if set, else the first of `~/.psmux.conf`, `~/.psmuxrc`, `~/.tmux.conf`, `~/.config/psmux/psmux.conf`; tmux option syntax, `bind-key`, `set-option`, `set-hook`, `source-file`, `if-shell`, `run-shell` are supported.
- Default shell is PowerShell 7 (pwsh) when on PATH, else Windows PowerShell, else cmd; `default-shell` can point at any shell, and cmd, Git Bash, WSL, and nushell panes can run side by side.
- Scripting: any tmux automation (bash, PowerShell, Python libtmux, control mode `-C`) runs against psmux on Windows without changes beyond Windows paths and shell quoting.
- Plugins: ports of the popular tmux plugins reimplemented in PowerShell (ppm, psmux-sensible, psmux-yank, psmux-resurrect, psmux-continuum, themes such as Catppuccin, Dracula, Nord, Tokyo Night, Gruvbox).
- Claude Code agent teams spawn teammates into psmux panes automatically when Claude Code runs inside a psmux session.
- Source and issues: https://github.com/psmux/psmux. Plugins: https://github.com/psmux/psmux-plugins.
